description: Returns alarm information from the NetBox system, optionally filtered by partition, alarm ID, event ID, activity ID or owner (wraps NBAPI GetAlarms). Responds with an ALARMS/ALARM collection; a system with no active alarms answers with an empty collection or a documented NOT FOUND.

ACTIVITYID.description: Optional. Return alarms for this activity ID.

ALLPARTITIONS.description: Optional. "TRUE" to return alarms across all partitions.

EVENTID.description: Optional. Return alarms raised by this event ID.

ID.description: Optional. Return the alarm with this alarm ID.

OWNERID.description: Optional. Return alarms owned by this operator/person ID.

PARTITIONKEY.description: Optional. Return alarms for this partition key only.

name: get_alarms
